notes.title: Hotfix #1 for Major Update 4: Riverlands!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42159392/bbda8c8c9181085be0f3684e0a66222a93b732fc.png"]
Dear Survivors 🌊,


We’re incredibly grateful for the amazing response to last week`s Major Update 4: Riverlands! Thank you all for the kind words, playthroughs, and support! 🙏

It’s been amazing to see so many of you diving into the Riverlands, uncovering secrets, dodging water beasts, and tackling the new survival challenges. 

Today, we’re releasing a quick Hotfix #1 to smooth out some issues from the update. Check the full list of Patch Notes below!
Hotfix #1 – Patch Notes Summary:
Ongoing improvements to Riverlands visuals, creature behavior, sounds, and resource spawning.

Fixes for key issues, including item interactions, collision bugs, weather inconsistencies, and visual glitches.

Please note that the Riverlands will receive further polish and fixes in the future. We’re continuing to monitor your feedback and polish the experience, so please keep sharing your thoughts, bug reports, and survival stories here or on our Discord! 

🌞 As most of our team will enjoy some well-earned vacation, these changes will go live with the next major patch. Good luck in the Riverlands, and watch out for the crocodiles... 🐊

See you soon! 

The Bootstrap Island Team! 🌴

Fixed spoiling bug

Fixed saltwater voiceover playing when drinking springwater

Added a new music track to the shipwreck area

Added more butterflies, insects, etc. to the Riverlands

notes.title: Major Update 4 - Riverlands! Live Now!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42159392/e704c52478a6764d8254872025bfb1fc9c88f471.gif"]
Major Update 4 – Riverlands Is Live! A massive new biome, game-changing mechanics, and fresh dangers. 

Dear Survivors,
Major Update #4 – Riverlands is here, and it’s our biggest update yet! The island has expanded beyond anything you’ve seen before. To reach the Riverlands, you’ll first have to defeat the Jungle Overlord in his Dark Lair... but what lies beyond is a lush new world - with its own dangers, of course.


Welcome to the Riverlands!  
The Riverlands is a vast, untamed biome larger than all previous areas combined. It’s a living, breathing wilderness shaped by flowing water, steep terrain, and deadly new fauna. Survival here demands new strategies and sharper instincts.


What’s New in Riverlands:

1- Unlimited Fresh Water 
Rivers, waterfalls, and streams flow throughout the region. Thirst is no longer your main concern… but don’t let your guard down.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42159392/9c9763e3626c8e4b7f166951a71569377a055547.gif"]
2- Electric Eel
A deadly aquatic predator that stuns or kills with brutal electric shocks. Swim carefully! But good source for food!  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42159392/f06fec5206fd54ed1900d400ac2c81c47feaf3e1.gif"]
3- Alligator-like Predator 
A stealthy, crocodile-like beast that ambushes from the riverbanks. One wrong step could be your last.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42159392/dcec934b624f6e474187f630a4cc56ced91c1485.gif"]
4- Musket Sling
You asked, we delivered. Carry your musket hands-free with this long-awaited upgrade. Unlocked after surviving several days, it marks your growth into a skilled survivor.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42159392/c0b48c4719e26b8c255f2b66b44475028043cb0f.gif"]
5- New Tropical Fruits
Discover powerful, nourishing fruits found only in the Riverlands.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42159392/49c040fe2929bb0837c968b9108ed1f2f2d9077e.gif"]
6- More Enhancements:
New features & effects – Shortcut to Riverlands, waterfalls, river debris, pollen, hand-triggered ripples, and fauna reactions.

Audio/visual upgrades – New music by Liina Sumera, voiceovers, sound effects, advanced graphics options, volcano overhaul.

Gameplay improvements – Fish can now be eaten alive; equipped items return smoothly; crates behave more reliably.


👉 When continuing an existing save:
All new systems and content should still work as intended with existing saves, but some new items might not spawn. Enjoy your adventure!


Bootstrap Island is also 30% OFF during the Summer Sale! 🌞Thank you for surviving with us! 🌴[previewyoutube="CV3xoHkXD3A;full"][/previewyoutube]

🚨Major Update 4: Patch Notes! SPOILER ALERT!🚨

New Content & Gameplay Updates
New area – Riverlands - A vast new biome with hidden secrets.

New fruit – Found only in the Riverlands, with hidden uses.

New enemy – A crocodile-like beast.

New water animal – Electric eel.

New waterbodies – Rivers and lakes with currents.

New feature – All water is now drinkable, including ocean water.

New unlockable – Musket sling, unlocked after surviving several days.

New feature – Shortcut to Riverlands.

New environmental effects – Waterfalls, river debris, pollen.

New effect – Water ripples on contact with hands.

New fauna effects – Exclusive to Riverlands.

Fish can now be eaten alive
[hr][/hr]Audio & Visual
New advanced graphics options – Ripple simulation, shadow distance, and more.

New voiceovers, sound effects, and music by Liina Sumera. Her music makes Riverlands a magical place to explore, in addition to some other new tracks.

Volcano has received an overhaul
[hr][/hr]Fixes & Improvements
Fixed satchel emptying or disappearing.

Fixed foliage not swaying in the wind; general foliage/landscape fixes.

Crates more reliable for carrying items.

Crates less common to find.

Equipped items return to the shoulder smoothly.

Water splash effects on animal contact.

Timing fix for the opening voiceover.

Spawner compatibility fixes when playing with older saves.

Warthog night audio changes.

Fixed sprinting stopping on game stutters.

Adjusted small finger to a more natural position.

 We welcome you on our Discord! Come and tell us about your survival adventure! 🌴🔥

notes.title: Roadmap to Bootstrap Island’s Full Release Revealed!
notes.notes:
The full vision of our VR survival game!
[previewyoutube=JObtRESe7tY;full][/previewyoutube]

Released Major Updates (1-2-3)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42159392/4940e45d68b46ad23f5f0cc4c443fd32dd2a82cb.png
The first three major updates have laid a strong foundation - introducing the inventory and building systems, allowing players to craft shelter and manage scarce resources. The terrifying Jungle Overlord boss fight added a major combat challenge, while the dynamic weather system brought unpredictability to every step.

Upcoming Major Updates
Major Update 4: Riverlands (Summer 2025)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42159392/0fd83d4d6037f8d15eb7e2592a26ee5f8324bb7b.png
This summer, the island expands. Major Update 4: Riverlands will introduce a vast new region shaped by rivers. But beware- these waters are dangerous. Expect new threats like gharial attacks, electric eels, and strong river currents that demand caution and new strategies.

You'll also find new resources like a tropical fruit, and wield the musket sling- a new tool for survival.

Major Update 5: Visions
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42159392/5f9226d52792fec663826285e0f6ca28fd165c1a.png
Next up, Major Update 5: Visions explores the psychological effects of survival. After a violent storm, you'll face sickness-induced hallucinations and flashback visions. Survival will no longer be just physical - it becomes mental.

Manage your condition with new medicinals, but tread carefully: quicksand adds a new environmental hazard. This update also introduces a tutorial to help newcomers adapt.

The Full Release
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42159392/daf4c79c3ad89b3cd553b1a5428a35398059d985.png
All roads lead to the full release, where the island’s deepest mysteries will come to light.

The arrival of tribal inhabitants - including a Shaman - will unlock rich social dynamics and narrative depth. Communication won’t rely on words. Players will use body language to build trust... or trigger aggression.

New tribal items and artifacts will deepen survival, story, and culture in a way that makes every encounter meaningful.

Full release planned for Q1 2026


Wishlist, follow, and stay updated as the island continues to evolve.

notes.title: Major Update 3 - Weather! Live Now!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42159392/f21ca3843a19f82863b8e806cf5c61c9b36e8c56.gifDear Survivors,

Major Update #3 - The Weather is Here!⛈️  

The island has changed forever! Weather now plays a crucial role in survival, dynamically shaping the world and affecting every aspect of gameplay. The new weather system doesn’t just add realism - it forces to think ahead, adapt, and truly engage with the environment. Every storm, every gust of wind, and every drop of rain can impact your survival. 

Survival Just Got Tougher:

 Fire-making and firearms are now impacted by wet conditions. Stay dry or risk losing essential tools.
 Water collection is now easier, making rainfall a valuable resource.
 Rain and wind affect visibility, movement, and planning. Watch the sky to anticipate the coming weather!
 Lightning is both a beauty and a threat - it can set objects ablaze and even injure you.

New Wildlife & Survival Features:

 The Wild Storm – A brutal survival event that will test your limits.
 Warthogs – Aggressive and territorial, these creatures attack without warning. A dangerous but rewarding food source! 
 Critters – Small lizards and frogs can now be caught by hand, with weapons, or even by throwing rocks. Eat them raw or cook them for a quick meal. 
 Roof Construction – A new shelter-building option with palm leaves to protect against rain and wind, ensuring better survival conditions. 

More Enhancements:
 
 Extended the length of a day and reduced the number of survival days required to unlock items.
 14 new original music tracks, tons of new sound effects, and new voiceover lines to heighten immersion. 
 Further optimized performance, including DLSS 3.8 support for a smoother experience. 


🙏 One more thing - if you enjoy the game and appreciate our work, please consider leaving a review on Steam! Your feedback helps us continue improving the game. Thank you for your support! 🙏

🤓 Please note: When continuing the game with an existing save, new animals and items do not spawn, as they weren’t part of the original seed when your game was generated. We also teleported you back to the starting beach, as we made some changes to the map and we do not want you to get stuck in the rocks. 
However, all new systems and content should function as intended. Happy surviving! 🌴

NB! We're currently working on a bug that may affect your unlocks in the game - hotfix coming soon!
 
[previewyoutube=fpMOXiwXKSs;full][/previewyoutube]

We welcome you on our Discord! Come and tell us about your survival adventure! 🌴🔥

🚨Major Update 3: Patch Notes! SPOILER ALERT!🚨

Dynamic Weather System

 Added a fully dynamic weather system that also plays a role in the story.
 Added rain to the game.
 Added wind to the game.
 Added lightning to the game.
 Added fog to the game.
 Remade the sky and cloud system for better realism.
 Added wind support to the foliage. 
 Added wind support to shipwreck sails.
 Added wetness support to the world.
 Refined how wetness works with objects, especially regarding fire. For example, you can now pour water on a torch to put it out. 
 Players' hands now get wet and dry based on environmental conditions.

New Creatures and Improved Interactions

 Added new beast to the game - Warthog. These can appear at night but also roam the island during the day.
 Added new critter to the game: the Frog
 Added new critter to the game: the Desert Spiny Lizard
 Refined the critter system in the game, so that you can even grab a crab alive, should you choose to do so.
 Improved animal behaviour near caves.

Story Progression

 Added a Chapter system, introducing two story chapters with specific start and end conditions. This lays the groundwork for future story expansions.

Building & Crafting

 Added new blueprint to the game - Roof, which provides shelter from rain and other dangers, but needs to be unlocked first.
 Added a new building material: Palm leaves, available after specific conditions have been met.

Survival & Exploration Adjustments

 Extended the length of a day for better pacing.
 Reduced the number of survival days required to unlock items.
 Filled up semi-caves on the starting beach, as these were very hard to use with rain. We know these were popular camping sites, sorry!
 Implemented a new ocean currents system for added realism and challenge.
 Improved night logic.
 Adjusted gameplay balance regarding some values.

Sound & Music

 Added a huge amount of new sound effects to the game.
 Added new voiceover lines to the game.
 Implemented 14 new original music tracks.

Bug Fixes & Performance

 Fixed an issue where Boots didn’t apply correctly when starting a new game.
 Improved the in-game menu usability while underwater.
 Added DLSS 3.8 support for improved performance and visual quality.
 Fixed a number of bugs.
 Fixed some issues with the level. 
 Further optimized performance for smoother gameplay.



We welcome you on our Discord! Come and tell us about your survival adventure! 🌴🔥

notes.title: Patch 0.2.1 Day Count Feature and Various Improvements!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42159392/e8fb85ab022f98c1e57651a767714a5587429062.png

Dear Survivors,

Patch 0.2.1 - Day Count Feature and Various Improvements is Now Live! 

This update introduces various bug fixes and some Quality of Life improvements to Bootstrap Island. In addition to adding a Day Count and Grab Toggle to the game, most of the teething issues with Satchel and Book of Building features should now be fixed. Most of the team is now working on some huge new things for the next Major Update but this is still months away from going live, so be patient!

Your feedback helps us shape the game, so please let us know what you think!

Patch 0.2.1 Notes:

1. New gameplay feature - Day Count.  When you open the in-game menu, you can see the current day count.

2. New gameplay setting - Grab Toggle.  If you switch to this mode, you don’t have to continuosly press the grab button to hold items.

3. Additional improvements:
* Wooden crates now burn when exposed to fire.
* Fixed a lagspike when placing items into Satchel.
* Improved some item placements in Satchel. Note that when you continue a pre-update game after updating, some objects in Satchel might have odd locations or rotations. Taking them out and putting them back in should fix the issue.
* Improved cordage tying when near fire.
* Cordage now properly gets wet and burns in fire.
* Cordage is now harder to find in the world.
* Satchel is now waterproof.
* Destroying a building using the book now returns all cordage.
* Destroying a building using force returns some cordage.
* Pistol now retains its cocked state when holstering and deholstering
* Fixed floatiness of the pistol, it now feels much more responsive.
* Fixed a bug where a deholstered pistol would not survive save/load.
* Reenabled seagull sounds and seagulls flying away during the night.
* Adjusted the material of building outlines and book line color.
* Improved building interactions and fixed related bugs.
* You can no longer place building outlines into rocks and other unreachable locations.
* Fixed endless ticking of equippable objects.
* Gate is now grabbable.
* Limited the number of non-started building outlines you can create to 8.
* Fixed fish appearing above water surface.
* Fixed issues with some animals not allowing meat harvesting.
* Fixed collision issues when drinking falling liquid.
* Improved pouring liquids into bottles.
* Damage to player hands now properly reduces health.
* Shooting player’s head with a firearm now more likely to be successful.
* Fixed some issues with geometry and foliage.
* Individual coconut meat piece is now cookable and burnable.
* Music no longer stops suddenly when exploring.
* Shipwreck debris items much less likely to spawn in the ground.

notes.title: Major Update #1 - Building and Inventory! Live Now!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42159392/a27cbd4e746914ba7d9f25c3ccdbe674542ecc21.jpg

Dear Survivors,

Major Update #1 - Building and Inventory is Now Live! 

We are thrilled to announce the release of our First Major Update since we launched the game into Early Access three months ago. This update introduces two highly anticipated features: an extensive building system and enhanced inventory management. These additions promise to elevate the survival experience and provide players with even more ways to explore and thrive on the ruthless island.

Your feedback helps us shape the game, so please let us know what you think!

[previewyoutube=4GTCUu7M-Qs;full][/previewyoutube]

Major Update #1 (Patch 0.2.0) Notes:

1. New unlockable item - Satchel. Note that the item has to be unlocked first and then found in chests. You can carry two satchels (one on your left shoulder, one on your right shoulder) and switch them out.

2. New unlockable item - Book of Building. Note that the item has to be unlocked first and then found in chests. You can use it to place plans for buildable structures and to destroy plans/structures.

3. Two recipes in the Book of Building - a wall and a gate. You can use both natural and shipwreck wood to build, given that it’s at proper length.

4, New usable plant - cordage root. Likes to grow on enbankments. Very useful for building but not indestructible. 

5. Revamped wood items to better accomodate building. Both natural and shipwreck wood pieces now fall into three categorys: longer pieces of wood, shorter pieces of wood, wood unfit for building. 

6. Greatly improved item selection mechanic  - makes it easier to pick up objects if there are several objects together.

7. New gameplay setting - grab selection. Item which is selected for grabbing is highlighted and displays a white “seal” icon. This option is on by default but can be turned off in settings. Note that grab selection is always enabled when taking items from Satchel.

8. Some shipwreck debris has washed ashore. You can use it to make your new home more cozy. 

9. Additional improvements:
* Climbable wall next to the liana in ravine now looks nicer. 
* Improved foliage in a number of places.
* Improved geometry in a number of places.
* Improved the interiors of caves.
* Fixed a large number of bugs.
* Fixed and improved some sounds.
* More music added to the game for exploration and nights. 
* Health, thirst and hunger bar animate when a value changes.
* Fixed issues with animal aggressions, they now attack if their numbers are sufficient. 

Known issues:
* Satchel and building still need some polish and bugfixing. Feedback and bug reporting is very welcome, as it helps us identifying issues.
* Seagulls are strangely quiet.
* There appears to be some issues with liquid pouring. We are looking into it.

We would love to see what you can build! Let us know what you think on our Discord!

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
The Bootstrap Island demo has been updated with some most requested features. The day is now significantly longer! We cleaned the flintlock pistol and reworked the hop-up system to be more useful.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42159392/618f3effb871ba9d5348997fc3885b7f408bc38b.gif

Hello, survivors! We have some news:

🌴 The endless mode of the Bootstrap Island demo has been updated with some most requested features. To access the endless mode, please right click the game in your Steam library, choose Properties, choose Betas, enter the code [b[morningcomes and choose “endless mode”. We would love to hear your feedback!

☀️ The day is now significantly longer! This is the most requested change and we implemented it to the endless mode, so give it a shot and let us know what you think.

🔫 We cleaned the flintlock pistol, turned out there was some sand and seawater in there. It's now much easier to use and more reliable. The current world record of beasts killed per night is 4, can you beat it?
🫳 Also significant, we reworked the hop-up system to be more useful. The way it works now is that you hold your palm facing the thing on the ground and then hop the item up to your hand. It might feel strange at first but it's noticeably slicker than before. Again, feedback is welcome!

🔥 There is no embargo on the endless version, you can feel free to make videos or share on social media. Please also note that currently the playtest key is not necessary to play the regular demo on Steam, as you can just download the demo from the Steam page but this might change in the future.
